title: ZIP to SCF to state table
description: Derived USPS Sectional Center Facility mapping. Primary table is 3-digit SCF prefix to two-letter state code; overrides map specific 5-digit ZIPs that resolve to a state different from their SCF's dominant state. ZIP keys are always strings to preserve leading zeros. Consumed by the Swift AddressDetector in Phase 3.

version.description: Schema version. Bump when the format changes in a way that requires a Swift-side decoder update.

generated_by.description: Identifier of the builder that produced this artifact.

seed.description: PRNG seed recorded for reproducibility. The ZIP-to-SCF derivation is not itself randomized; this field is included for uniformity with other Phase 1 artifacts.

source_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the raw USPS source file this table was derived from.

source_retrieval_date.description: ISO date on which the raw source was fetched.

zip_key_type.description: Swift decoder contract: ZIP keys in scf_table and overrides are three-digit and five-digit strings respectively. Never parse them as integers (leading zeros are significant).

scf_table.description: Map from 3-digit SCF prefix to two-letter USPS state code.

overrides.description: Map from 5-digit ZIP to two-letter USPS state code, for ZIPs whose state differs from the dominant state of their SCF prefix.

notes.description: Optional human note. Must comply with mechanism-description language rules.
